topic: An employee is transferred to a different department
text: I just found out I’m being moved to a different department. They say it’s an opportunity, but I can’t shake the feeling that this is a setback. All the progress I’ve made, the connections I’ve built – it feels like I’m starting over. I need to prove myself again, and there’s so much to learn in this new role. I’m worried about the timeline, too. They’re pushing for a quick transition, and I’m not sure I can get up to speed that fast. I’ve got to figure out how to manage this, to show them I’m the right fit, even here. I can’t afford to slip up.
